name: cTSWantTreeLoader::LoadTree (one want tree resource into the manager: reads the record by key, parses it with the framework's expat parser through a new tree loader)
notes: Hooked (lane IL). Difftest WantTreeLoader_Load: 1500 seeds; a scripted parser (fake slot 3 replays random start/end/character events, both sides receiving the same script; slot 8 sets the handler, slots 14/15 push and pop it for property sets) drives the game's loader (original) and ours; random plans for record found/QI/stream/parser creation, a pre-populated trees map and node Keep results. Compares the event log of every fake call (resource manager, record, stream, framework, parser, nodes), the manager's trees map and each node's fields (weights, superZero, the age/aspiration/personality maps, the ranges, parent/children/id/properties), the fakes' refcounts, and the unknown-tag maps and version flags (image statics 0x10db040/0x10db04c/0x10db03c/0x10db03d against ours). The nodes are ours on both sides (src/ts/cTSWantNode.h; the original side's constructor 0x5b2750 CodePatched to our adapter, as the hook does in game) and every node the trees reach is compared after each event; GetDefinition (the Keep test) asks a fake app singleton whose want manager answers a definition fake or nothing. Scripts always start with an ads element: the original leaves the ads fields unset at construction until then. Mutants (tools/mutate.py, filter WantTreeLoader, 44 across the class, the last the low-byte GetDefinition read; run again on the real-node test): 42 killed; equivalent survivors: #22 the editorValues early return in EndElement removed (the only extra work is dropping the property loader and set, which are always null then: they are set only by a property-set start, which StartElement skips inside editorValues, and the parser routes every event to the property loader until its end tag, which drops them), #27 the trees[id] == mNode check removed (a parentless mNode is always the map's entry for mTreeId: it was inserted there when created, mTreeId changes only while mNode is null, and the entry is removed only by this path, which then drops mNode). Not run in game.

name: cTSWantTreeLoader::cTSWantTreeLoader (constructor: vtable, fields cleared, factor 7)
notes: Hooked (lane IL, adapter: placement new of ours). Difftest WantTreeLoader_Slots (300 seeds): a loader from the image's operator new 0x824632 plus the original constructor against ours; every field compared except the high half of the word at +0x38 (the original stores a 16-bit word at 0x551c15, leaving +0x3a/+0x3b as the heap left them; ours are padding). Also covered by WantTreeLoader_Adapters (the original LoadTree with the five adapters patched in, 300 seeds).

name: cTSWantTreeLoader::Reset (drops the parser, the manager, the node, the property set and the property loader)
notes: Hooked (lane IL). Difftest WantTreeLoader_Slots (Reset via 0x556240 against ours on loaders with random counted fields; refcounts and fields compared) and WantTreeLoader_Adapters.

name: cTSWantTreeLoader::Release (refcount at +0x2c; releases the node, set, property loader and parser and deletes the loader at zero)
notes: Hooked (lane IL). Difftest WantTreeLoader_Slots: AddRef/Release sequences on loaders holding random counted fields; refcounts, fakes' counts and heap state compared. Also WantTreeLoader_Adapters.

name: cTSWantTreeLoader::StartElement (tree/wantNode/cGZPropertySetString/editorValues/ads/bool/range elements: builds the want node tree and opens property-set reads)
notes: Hooked (lane IL). Covered by WantTreeLoader_Load (see 0x5550c0): every element, attribute and value name of the cells 0x1015de4..0x1015eb8 is drawn by the script generator, plus unknown names; and by WantTreeLoader_Adapters.

name: cTSWantTreeLoader::EndElement (closes nodes, attaches or drops property sets, writes the bool and range factors into the node)
notes: Hooked (lane IL). Covered by WantTreeLoader_Load (see 0x5550c0) and WantTreeLoader_Adapters. GetDefinition's result (slot 14) is tested as a whole pointer, as the original does (0x552b3f); the first version read its low byte only, which the fake node's bool answer hid; the real-node test checks it.

name: cTSWantPropertySetLoader::~cTSWantPropertySetLoader (scalar deleting destructor: releases the parser, then the cGZPropertySetSerializerXmlString base)
notes: Covered by WantTreeLoader_Load (every property set opened by a script is read through the loader and released; refcounts compared) and mutant #43 (empty destructor) killed. In effect through its callers (lane IL): only the game vtable of cTSWantPropertySetLoader refers to it, and only StartElement's original 0x553210 builds that class (its constructor is inlined there); StartElement's original is itself reached only through the tree loader's game vtable, which only the hooked constructors store (callers.py), so every property loader is ours and the host traps the original under those switches.

name: cTSWantPropertySetLoader::EndElement (the serializer's end element; at the property set's own end tag pops the parser's handler and hands the end to the tree loader)
notes: Covered by WantTreeLoader_Load (see 0x5550c0): scripts open property sets with random properties and nested elements; the parser's push/pop calls and the tree loader's resulting state are compared. In effect through its callers (lane IL): see 0x5528f0.
